_comment: DATA-ONLY WATCHLIST (added 2026-09-13) — see watchlist_eodhd.json for why these names are held out of M1. Runs inside the borrow pod BEFORE the main pass, into data_borrow/watchlist/history/<T>.json; build_m1 reads data_borrow/history/ only. iBorrowDesk history ONLY: `countries` is empty because the IBKR usa.txt snapshot already lists every shortable US name (all of these included) and the main pass stores it whole — a second copy would be pure duplication. Same iBorrowDesk rules as the main pass (20 s pacing, 3-day freshness, per-IP ban). 2026-09-16: the 11 promoted names moved to the main pass — borrow.json's iborrowdesk reads its universe from tickers.json, so promoting them there moved them automatically — leaving BRK-B + SPY/QQQ, ~1 min and 3 requests on a refresh night. Their history/ and history_v2/ files moved to data_borrow/ with them; history_v2/<T>.json is the per-symbol done marker for the metered v2 allowance, so leaving it behind would have re-billed 11 units. BRK-B resolves to iBorrowDesk's BRK.B via the fetcher's dual-class alias.

iborrowdesk_v2._comment: ALL-TIME daily OHLC (fee/rebate/available, back to 2015-07) from the keyed v2 API on the Patreon $10+ allowance: 500 units/month, resetting the 1st UTC, 1 unit = 365 days of one symbol. Universe = intraday.json's research names (stocks + market) that THIS pass's iborrowdesk universe also holds: the main pass takes the ones in tickers.json (103 after the 2026-09-16 promotion, was 92), watchlist_borrow.json the other 2 (SPY, QQQ — was 13). Rows merge into history/<T>.json with EXISTING rows winning; the raw payload (figi, previous_identities, full OHLC) lands in history_v2/<T>.json and is the per-symbol done marker. A spent allowance defers the rest to the first run after the reset and never fails the borrow run. Needs IBORROWDESK_API_KEY in runpod/.env.
iborrowdesk_v2._exclude_stocks_from: BRK-B is in both tickers.json and this watchlist; the main pass owns it, so it is billed once
iborrowdesk_v2._overlap_free_window_days: stop the request short of today at the fewest whole units whose span still overlaps the free endpoint's rolling year by this many days (those days are already in history/). null = all-time, one extra unit per symbol.
